queries.name: physical_identity_contract
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (250)
 t.name AS tabla, c.name AS columna,
 ty.name AS tipo, c.max_length,
 c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name IN (
 'Operaciones_Tablaje_Ordenes',
 'Operaciones_Tablaje_OrdenesDetalle',
 'Operaciones_Tablaje_EventosContables',
 'Inventario_Movimientos',
 'Inventario_MovimientosDetalle',
 'Inventario_TipoMovimiento',
 'Tablajeria_MovimientosInventario',
 'Tablajeria_PolizasContables',
 'Tablajeria_PolizasDetalle'
)
AND (
 c.name LIKE '%ID'
 OR c.name IN (
 'Codigo','TipoEvento','ReferenciaTipo',
 'ReferenciaDetalleTipo','ReferenciaID',
 'FolioReferencia','Cantidad','CostoUnitario',
 'EstatusContable','FechaOperacionMexico'
 )
)
ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: movement_type_catalog
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
 TipoMovimientoID, Codigo, Descripcion,
 Naturaleza, AfectaCostoPromedio, Activo
FROM dbo.Inventario_TipoMovimiento
ORDER BY Codigo;

queries.name: identity_mapping_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (150)
 t.name AS tabla, c.name AS columna,
 ty.name AS tipo
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id
WHERE (
 t.name LIKE '%Empresa%'
 OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%'
 OR t.name LIKE '%UnidadNegocio%'
)
AND (
 c.name LIKE '%ID'
 OR c.name LIKE '%Codigo%'
 OR c.name LIKE '%PK'
)
ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: unique_indexes
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (150)
 t.name AS tabla, i.name AS indice,
 i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key,
 c.name AS columna, ic.key_ordinal
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN sys.index_columns ic
 ON ic.object_id=i.object_id
 AND ic.index_id=i.index_id
JOIN sys.columns c
 ON c.object_id=ic.object_id
 AND c.column_id=ic.column_id
WHERE t.name IN (
 'Inventario_Movimientos',
 'Inventario_MovimientosDetalle',
 'Operaciones_Tablaje_EventosContables',
 'Tablajeria_MovimientosInventario',
 'Tablajeria_PolizasContables',
 'Tablajeria_PolizasDetalle'
)
AND i.is_unique=1
AND ic.key_ordinal>0
ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: parallel_history_counts
queries.sql:
SELECT 'MOVIMIENTOS' AS origen,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS total
FROM dbo.Tablajeria_MovimientosInventario
UNION ALL
SELECT 'POLIZAS', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Tablajeria_PolizasContables
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ASIENTOS', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.Tablajeria_PolizasDetalle;

queries.name: accounting_event_status
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (50)
 TipoEvento, EstatusContable,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS total
FROM dbo.Operaciones_Tablaje_EventosContables
GROUP BY TipoEvento,EstatusContable
ORDER BY TipoEvento,EstatusContable;
